title: Source-dependent gains and tail errors in visual recorded-force prediction for surgical robotics: frozen replay code
description: Portable frozen-output metric replay and three cached-feature/head inference examples for D76 manuscript v2.4. Includes both chicken views and SinglePSM, all original pass/fail gates and failed GRU/anchor-cap diagnostics. These previously exposed public sources were retrained separately; this artifact is not blind external validation, direct weight transfer, raw-video replay, or complete training reproduction. Lang Yang, Chuan-Xin Duan and Xixi Gao contributed equally and share first authorship, listed in that order. Code: MIT; source-derived numerical data: CC BY 4.0, see NOTICE.md.
